# Gradia

> A portable WebGL gradient engine and visual editor by Plinka.

- Studio: https://gradia.plinka.eu
- Repository: https://github.com/ExtraBinoss/Gradia
- Agent guide: https://gradia.plinka.eu/docs/agents.md
- Integration: https://gradia.plinka.eu/docs/integration.md
- Architecture: https://gradia.plinka.eu/docs/architecture.md
- Download kit: https://gradia.plinka.eu/gradia-kit.zip
- Standalone ESM: https://gradia.plinka.eu/lib/gradia.min.js

Use Code in the studio to copy an exact preset and agent prompt. Do not import the editor UI to reuse the engine. The plain JS engine has no dependencies; the React adapter requires React.
